resources.string: This page provides an AI-powered overview of your business performance and future projections.
This page visualizes deep performance trends and future demand forecasts using historical transaction data.
Visualizes the relationship between your total sales and actual earnings over time.
Algorithm: Time-Series Aggregation\nFormula: Daily Profit = Σ(Price - Cost) per day\nUses Descriptive Analytics to show historical trends and identify period-over-period growth.
Shows when your business is most active during the day.
Algorithm: Hourly Frequency Distribution\nLogic: Aggregates transaction timestamps into 24-hour bins. Uses Diagnostic Analytics to help you understand staffing needs and optimal operating hours.
Predicts future sales volume for your top products.
Algorithm: Weighted Moving Average\nFormula: Fₜ₊₁ = (w₁Vₜ + w₂Vₜ₋₁ + w₃Vₜ₋₂) / Σw\nUses Predictive Analytics to estimate future inventory needs based on recent sales velocity and trends.
Ranks your products by the total number of units sold.
Algorithm: Pareto Distribution Analysis\nLogic: Identifies the "Vital Few" products that drive the majority of your sales volume using Descriptive Analytics.
Calculates your Gross Profit and Average Margin. It summarizes what happened in your business recently.

Algorithm: Descriptive Aggregation
Formula: Profit = Σ(Price - Cost)
Margin: (Total Profit / Revenue) × 100
This module uses Descriptive Analytics to summarize historical raw data into something understandable.
Analyzes sales patterns and product relationships to provide actionable advice.

Algorithm: Pattern Recognition / Association Rules\nLogic: Analyzes the "Why" by looking for correlations between items and time periods. It uses Diagnostic Analytics to find the root cause of sales trends.
Uses historical data to predict your future revenue and daily sales averages.
Algorithm: Linear Regression / Time Series Analysis\nFormula: ŷ = mx + b (Trend Projection)\nUses Predictive Analytics to forecast future outcomes based on historical patterns and seasonality.
Identifies low-stock items that are high-priority based on their sales velocity.
Algorithm: Inventory Optimization\nFormula: ROP = (Average Daily Sales × Lead Time) + Safety Stock\nUses Prescriptive Analytics to suggest a specific course of action to prevent stockouts.
Bizpalm is your AI-powered business management companion. This guide explains our modules and how our analytics help you grow.

The Dashboard is your control center. Tap any card to navigate. The notification bell shows real-time alerts for low stock or business updates. Pressing back from notifications safely returns you here.

Management: Add or edit products with barcodes, prices, and costs.\n\nRestock Recommendations (Prescriptive AI): Not just a list—this module uses an optimization algorithm [ROP = (Avg Sales × Lead Time) + Safety Stock] to tell you exactly what to buy to avoid stockouts.

Found on the main page, this module provides high-level business health:

Financial Pulse (Descriptive): Summarizes recent profitability using [Profit = Σ(Price - Cost)].

AI Consultant (Diagnostic): Analyzes sales patterns to give you actionable advice on item pairings and business trends.

Advanced visualizations for long-term planning:

Revenue vs Profit: Tracks your growth trends over time.

Peak Hours: Diagnoses your busiest times to optimize staffing.

Demand Forecast (Predictive): Projects future sales volume using a Weighted Moving Average algorithm.

Sales Volume: Uses Pareto Distribution to identify the 20%% of products generating 80%% of your volume.
POS: Scan barcodes to build a cart, calculate change, and generate receipts instantly.\n\nTransactions: A complete searchable history of every sale, including itemized breakdowns and profit data.

Advanced Help: Look for the \'?\' icon in the corner of analytics pages. Toggle \"Show Advanced Details\" to see the logic and math behind our AI.\n\nSettings: Manage your security PIN, toggle alerts, and handle data resets.
Our AI categories (Descriptive, Diagnostic, Predictive, Prescriptive) work together to ensure you always know what happened, why it happened, and what to do next.
